senses.definition: To save data somewhere it will survive a restart or a refresh.
distractors: To turn an object in memory into bytes that can be sent over a wire.
To replace a running component without stopping the system around it.
To make a bad situation worse.
To avoid something deliberately and on principle.
To settle which of two possible readings is the one meant.

senses.definition: Staying with something long after most people would have stopped.
distractors: Weight and seriousness in how a person carries themselves.
Being aware of something and visibly taking it into account.
Tangled into something so completely that you can no longer act on your own.
Low in a way that has given up on things improving.
Alert and responsive to something, picking up its signals early and adjusting.
